title: Safe Harness Bootstrap
description: Declarative smoke pack for inspecting the V1 Safe Harness Bootstrap workflow without executing scripts.

steps.title: Audit Target
steps.description: Run the read-only audit command and inspect missing files, conflicts, unknowns, and next safe command.

steps.title: Initialize Or Skip
steps.description: Create missing Harness files only when the target has no conflicting files.

steps.title: Validate Harness
steps.description: Run wiki, handoff, and doctor validation; record command output as evidence.
